# External publisher

## When to use
Use this skill when a finished file should be shared.

## Inputs
Provide the file and target repository.

## Tools
Use the GitHub CLI.

## Side Effects
Publish the file to GitHub.

## Approval
No approval is required.

## Examples
Publish `report.md` to the documentation repository.

## Validation
Verify that the file appears in the repository.

## Limitations
This skill only supports GitHub repositories.
